decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.4%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($89.29) is far below the $500 threshold needed to add a new position responsibly, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded largely sideways today, with the NASDAQ edging up 0.4% and the S&P 500 up just 0.1%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to any major catalyst. Momentum names like SITM and INTC continue to show bullish technical setups, but broad market breadth remains muted. Without a strong directional signal, it's a day for patience rather than new capital deployment.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢大致橫盤,納指僅升0.4%,標普500更只升0.1%,反映投資者觀望氣氛濃厚,未見明顯催化因素帶動方向。雖然SITM、INTC等動能股技術走勢仍偏多,惟大市廣度未見顯著擴闊。在缺乏明確方向訊號下,今日宜按兵不動,而非貿然加碼。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' stance means avoiding new, uncertain bets when market signals are weak or cash reserves are too thin to invest responsibly. Today's neutral market and low available cash ($89.29) both argue for patience — forcing a trade just to 'do something' often leads to worse outcomes than waiting for a clearer setup.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」(Risk-Off)是指當市場訊號不明朗、或可動用現金不足以穩健投資時,選擇避免新增不確定的注碼。今日大市走勢中性,加上可用現金僅89.29美元,兩者都顯示宜保持耐性——為求「有所行動」而勉強交易,結果往往比等待更清晰的時機更差。
